L672: IV. E XPERIMENTAL R ESUL TS AND A NALYSI S
L673: A. Design of Learning P arameters
L674: 
L675: Several parameters need to be designed throughout the learn-
L676: 
L677: ing algorithm, including scalar parameter λ in (3), iteration

L679: number L, step size μ, and the number of atoms N in the
L680: 
L681: dictionary. λ balances the reconstruction error and the sparsity
L682: 
L683: level. A large λ will cause a great dif ference between the
L684: 
L685: primary sample and the reconstructed result, whereas a small λ
L686: 
L687: cannot assure the sparsity level during the learning process. In

L689: 
L690: L and step size μ determine the accuracy while approaching the

L693:
